notes: Sacred Ground image split. Morning = specialty library only (no seasons). Night = same uploaded storefront vein + seasonal outdoors (leaves, flowers, snow) + optional night sky mood.

daytime.how_it_works: Keep using the uploaded specialty images (tarot, reiki, shamanic, etc.) exactly as today. No seasonal overlays for morning posts.

nighttime.base_style: Same vein as the uploaded Sacred Ground exterior storefronts (blue awning, stone facade, crystal cart, warm interior glow). Do not invent a different building.

spring.look: spring blooms and fresh greenery around the storefront / sidewalk / planters

summer.look: summer flowers and lush green around the storefront

fall.look: autumn leaves (amber, rust, gold) around the storefront and sidewalk

winter.look: soft winter snow on sidewalk, awning edge, and around the crystal cart — still inviting, not bleak

moods.sunset: golden / pink evening sky, storefront lit
moods.starry: clear night, soft stars, gentle shop glow
moods.window_glow: lit windows and shop warmth, quieter sky
moods.full_moon: large full moon — ONLY when the moon is actually full

full_moon.source: astronomical full moon for America/Chicago date

nighttime.how_it_combines: Hero is always the same Sacred Ground exterior style. Season changes the outdoors (flowers / leaves / snow). Sky mood can still rotate (sunset, twilight, stars, full moon). Events stay in the caption.
